scripts.dev: bun run code:generate && wrangler dev --config packages/agent/wrangler.jsonc --env pilot --local
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run ontology:check && bun scripts/code-revision.ts --check
scripts.build: bun run code:generate && wrangler deploy --config packages/agent/wrangler.jsonc --env pilot --dry-run --outdir "$PWD/dist/agent"
scripts.worker:types: wrangler types packages/agent/worker-configuration.d.ts --config packages/agent/wrangler.jsonc --env pilot --include-env false
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config packages/agent/wrangler.jsonc --env pilot --local
scripts.dev:fixture: bun run code:generate && wrangler dev --config packages/agent/wrangler.jsonc --env fixture --local
scripts.db:migrate:fixture: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config packages/agent/wrangler.jsonc --env fixture --local
